title: Orders for nafila prayer by MaulanaSheikhNazim
body:
Every Day
"It is a good advice for everyone to pray every morning before Fajr, "Subhana Rabbi-l
wal hamdi, subhan alathi wa'staghir'ullah..." Do this 100 times between sunna and fard
prayers in the morning." IlluminateYourHeart
"After morning praying, till sun rising, make 1ooo x ‘Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim’.
Continue on it 4o days, then going to appear to you some rays of Nur, heavenly Lights. For every 4o days that
rays going to be more stronger, till you can look and see what is in Malakut, Heavens! Who can do may do,
through 4o days, must appear a ray from Heavens to his heart." BasisOfTrueServanthood
"Try it! Free! Trying is free; make it for one day that: 'I am going to say and to work on something today, to
say: Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim!' And finally look yourself at the end of the day and one day that you (are)
never saying the holy Name of Allah, to say: Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim." FashionsAndThings
"Astaghfirullah- We have to say this at least 100 x daily for Allah to accept our request for forgiveness."

FriendsOfAllahLookAfterThousandsOfWorlds
"Therefore- at least daily you put your forehead for your Lord for Sajdah and at least you must say 70x :
Astaghfirullah, Astaghfirullah, Astaghfirullah… O our Lord, forgive us!"

HeavenlyWarningHearListenAndObey
"Audhu bi-llahi mina shaitani rajim ... at least 40 x daily you must use it, to be powerful, (because) that
Shaitan (is) rushing on you!" MubarakForNewBeginning1429

"Therefore, I advise you all to awaken sometime during the last third of the night: even for five minutes. You
must, however, be in a state of ritual purity. Then you must address your Lord: Oh my lord, come to me, as I
can’t come to You." PerfumeOfAttraction
Say at least 70 Astaghfirullah everyday. Send salatu salams 70 times. Say 70 times La Ilaha Illa Llah.

WalkingCastle
Rabbiul Awwal
To glorify our Prophet (sas), say not less than 1000x salawat daily. MonthOfMawlidStarting
Muharram
"In the month of Ashura, everyday make 40 salawat shariff tunjina: 100 times, Hasbuna Allah Rabbuna
Allah. 100 times say Bismillah er Rahman er Rahim. 100 times Ikhlas al Sharif. 100-1000 Salawat al Shariff."

Muharram
Safar
"We have been ordered to make at least two raka`ats sajdah for our Lord and to ask forgiveness, even two
raka`ats, and to say 300 times astaghfirullah." InstructionsForSafar
"Safar is the heaviest of months and I am fearing something happens through this month. As a protection,
our grandshaykh (q) was saying that daily you must keep three times (recite) Kalimatu 'sh-Shahadah and 300
times astaghfirullah, and give sadaqah of even one penny (small daily charity), and keep at least one sajdah
daily and pray for Ummah of Sayyidina Muhammad (s)." HonorIsToKnowWhatAllahLovesMost
Rajab
"I like whom they are going to be here to fast Thursday and Monday and keep yourself a little bit more saying,
laa ilaaha illa-Llah Muhammadun Rasoolullah, and Darood Shareef. And try to make a khatm (one full
reading of Holy Qur'an) while you are here; it is good for you." GuidanceForRajab
Rajab and Shaban
"Wenigstens könnt ihr euch eine halbe Stunde vor dem Morgengebet bis zum Sonnenaufgang und nach dem
Nachmittagsgebet bis zum Abendgebet eine halbe Stunde (zum Rückzug) hinsetzen und zwischen Abend-

und Nachtgebet ebenfalls nur eine halbe Stunde."

RückzugInDenHeiligenMonatenRamadanUndRagab
Dhul-Hijjah
"Tomorrow [8th Dhul-Hijjah] you must try to complete 1000 Ikhlas-u-Sharif; 1000 La ilaha ill’Allah; 1000
Salawat; 100 La ilaha ill’Allah, wahdahu la sharika’lah, lahu’l mulku wa lahu’l hamdu, yuhyi wa yumit, wa
Huwa ‘ala kulli shayin Qadir; 100 La haula wa la quwatta illa bi’llahi’l ‘Aliyu’l ‘Azim, and at every prayer to
make the Tekbir: 'Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, la ilaha ill’Allah, wa Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar wa li’llahi’l
hamd.' " Hajjulakbar1999LabbaikAllahummalabbaik
At the Dergah/Mosque
"Whoever is responsible in that area should recite one Surah al-Fath each day. Surah al-Fath is very
important; it is a great, majestic surah. Therefore, keep up with that practice and do not fear. Is there an
imam? Even if there isn’t, whoever it may be, let him recite one Surah al-Fath at the masjid everyday, because
the world has entered into a very tough and difficult point. The only way to overcome this will be through the
power of imaan. Those with no imaan will fall off." YouAndIAreServants
For Countries
"Inform Indonesia to read Qul Ya Azeem before every adhaan. People who listen to us from any association
must read this. Reading this will protect you from tsunamis; it will prevent it from happening. Listeners must
read it. ... make it a habit." InstructionsForQulYaAzeem
